title: Every promise

lines.text: Every promise in the book is mine
Every chapter, every verse, every line
Every promise of His Love Divine,
Every promise in the Book is mine.
Every promise for the Bride is mine,
Every Message, every quote, every line
Every promise of His Love Divine,
Every promise for the Bride is mine.

[E]Every promise for the Bride is [A]mine,

Every promise of His Love Divine,
Every [B]promise for the Bride is [E]mine.
